jobs.name: mage
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: very simple low-resolution game character animation sheet. Input image 1 is ONLY the character costume/color concept reference; use ONLY the specified character from that lineup. Input image 2 is the authoritative PIXEL STYLE, SMALL BODY PROPORTION and EXISTING CORRECT FULL-BODY WALK POSE reference. Create a new complete character sheet, with exactly four sprites in the same 2x2 equal-cell layout as image2: idle top-left, walkA top-right, walkB bottom-left, happy purchase bottom-right. Use the EXACT same head-to-body ratio, short limb lengths, coarse pixel size, camera direction and walking choreography as image2, changing the entire character identity and costume to the specified character in image1. The concept image1 is too detailed and tall; only take its big garment shapes and colors, not its realistic proportions, shading, surface details or decorative trim. HARD square low-resolution pixel clusters with simple dark outline, about24 colors, at most2-3 tones per material. Adult in compact RPG proportions; roughly32x47 logical-pixel body,48x64 cell, oversized hat may add height. No scene, letters, labels, border, ground shadows or extra characters. TRUE transparent alpha outside all sprites. Do NOT retain traveler backpack/bedroll. Every sprite newly authored as a coherent FULL BODY, never a fixed torso with pasted legs. Keep same head size, face and clothing across all4 poses. The walking pair MUST use the actual opposite anatomical legs and opposite arm positions of image2: walkA visible near thigh/knee forward and far leg behind; walkB darker far thigh/knee forward and near leg behind. Match the shoulder-elbow-hand counter-swing and foot heel/toe orientation in the two corresponding template poses. Retain side-facing left direction, tail/hair/accessory stays on back side; never mirror entire figure. Body weight moves onto each alternating planted foot, other foot lifts behind. Front-leg identity follows actual hip-to-knee-to-foot chain, not color stripes. DO NOT add gold boot bands to fake foot switching. Clothing follows the actual forward thigh and has opposite folds/hem swing between poses. Hands empty while walking so arm counter-swing can be seen. Happy purchase has an empty palm to receive a game-rendered bottle, no item/particles baked in. Do not replace any original flowing garment with trousers or a short tunic for convenience.
Character from reference: Use the THIRD character in image1: female mage, long messy violet hair, oversized floppy dark-purple witch hat, floor/ankle-length loose PURPLE ROBE with wide sleeves, brown belt and simple book at hip, a modest split in robe that reveals one knee when stepping, short brown footwear visible only below hem. Keep the LONG ROBE in every frame; NO trousers, NO short coat, NO tights. The robe billows slightly around the alternating forward thigh, the near-side slit and exposed leg follow the near anatomical leg into front inA and back inB. Robe outline moves opposite sides and does not conceal both moving feet. Simplify completely: plain purple cloth, hat has only simple brown/gold band, no embroidery, chains, pendants, ornaments or bottle cluster. Face tired but normal pale cheeks: dark circles are only a faint muted gray-brown short 2-logical-pixel by1-pixel shadow directly below each eye. No large purple cheek patch or bruises, no giant eye-mask; pupils and cheeks distinct.
jobs.correction_prompt: Edit the attached 2x2 complete purple mage sprite sheet. Keep SAME long robe, hat, purple hair, short brown footwear, compact low-resolution pixel style, simplified colors and faint thin under-eye shadows. Top-left idle, top-right walkA, bottom-right happy purchase stay as they are. Redraw ONLY the BOTTOM-LEFT ENTIRE WALKING FIGURE into the OPPOSITE full-body stride. Critical leg placement in bottom-left: the BARE PALE NEAR KNEE and its boot are BEHIND the pelvis on the SCREEN-RIGHT side, leg angled down-right, rear knee bends, heel raised. The front foot at SCREEN-LEFT belongs to the FAR LEG entirely covered by DARK PURPLE ROBE, no bare skin at all on screen-left lower body. Open the near-side robe slit on the RIGHT/rear side, not the LEFT/front side. The currently exposed pale knee at screen-left in bottom-left MUST DISAPPEAR from that left/front location and appear on right/rear. This is not a color swap, change entire hip/thigh/knee/boot geometry and robe folds. Near-side shoulder and arm swing FORWARD to SCREEN-LEFT with near elbow and hand at left waist; far arm swings BACK to screen-right. Reverse shoulder/hip twist slightly but keep head/hat location stable. Do not mirror the face, hat or book; book remains at same belt side. Both contact frames must now show bare near-leg on LEFT/front in TOP-RIGHT, and bare near-leg on RIGHT/rear in BOTTOM-LEFT. No new pants, no short coat, no details added. Entire bottom-left sprite coherent anew, no leg splice under old torso. Same strict 2x2 grid, true transparent alpha.
